title: Analysis code for: Multi-cohort transcriptomic and single-cell analysis identifies polyp-associated expression of COL10A1 in fibroblasts in chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps
description: Numbered R and shell scripts that reproduce all analyses, tables and figures of the manuscript from public GEO data (systematic dataset search, multi-cohort meta-analysis, consensus-gene selection, baseline and specificity analyses, and two single-cell datasets), together with all result tables.
